{{Top|leg}}
'''Striders''' were six-legged reptiles ridden on [[Sedesia]]. They grew 1.5-2.5 meters tall at the shoulder and 6-8 meters long. They had long, whip-like tails and sharp tusks. They were noted for their speed, stamina, and orneriness; the males could be outright vicious.
